name: Youtou Densetsu
source:
Jubei is a high school student who comes from a shaman family of shrine protectors. The shrines hold the barrier between this world and Makai. One day the barrier gets breached and closest people to Jubei get attacked by a monster.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
十兵卫是一名高中生，出身于世代守护神社的巫觋家族。这些神社维持着人界与魔界之间的结界。一天，结界遭到突破，十兵卫身边最亲近的人也受到妖怪袭击。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
